Name: Gapless Paths
Author: RainbowSparkles29
Description:
[left][size=4][/size][/left][center][left][size=4][/size][/left][/center][size=4]Hate that the stone walkway doesn't fit with your other paths?
Like the aesthetics of the weathered floor but not the damage it has?[/size]

Me too!

It bothered me so much, I started looking around for a mod to fix it, thinking, surely, someone would come to my rescue.
Alas, I found nothing.

Then I realised, wait, I can just fix it myself.

[b]Includes a config[/b], so if you just want one and not the other, you've got the option.

This mod was made solely for personal use but I figured I'd upload it for fun. For that reason changes or updates aren't planned, but if anyone has specific requests, maybe I'll get round to them. No promises!

Thanks for checking this out! Have a great day <3

Manifest.Name: Gapless Paths
Manifest.Description: Alters the stone walkway and weathered floor textures to remove gaps, allowing them to fit together with other paths.
Manifest.Author: RainSparks29
